meta.unit: one sigma = trailing 52-week weekly standard deviation before the signal; paths side-signed on daily closes from the entry close
meta.method: Point-in-time Desk replay (research/replay), fixed variant, graded prime/setup/developing rows with a side. Entry: close of the first trading day after the signal Friday. Stops at k sigma and targets at 2k and 3k are tested on closes over 91 calendar days. Drift rows remove each market's own in-sample mean daily return. No costs, no slippage, no intraday fills.
meta.baseline_note: Baseline cells run the same first-passage rules on every Friday since 2012 for both sides, so they show what a stop at k sigma and a target at 2k would have done with no setup at all. For a driftless walk the target-first share is 1/3 at 2R and 1/4 at 3R before the time cap.
meta.execution: Two execution models in R units of the original stop. full: one unit at the entry close, stop -1R, target +T R, otherwise marked at the final close. scale: half a unit at entry; when a close reaches +1R before -1R the other half is added at that close and the stop for the whole position moves to the lowest close of the prior ten sessions (never below the original stop); target stays at +T R; otherwise marked at the final close. Profit factor = gross R won / gross R lost; 1.0 is break-even before costs. For a fixed T:1 payoff with win rate w, PF = wT/(1-w).
meta.caveat: Replay history for a class of setups. Not a probability for any live trade. Cells with n under 40 are not reported; market-own cells (level 9) use n >= 15 and are labelled.
